attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair, brows, and conditional facial hair. The subject is a bareheaded civilian bust with short, neatly side-parted dark brown/black hair, a high forehead, and real brow hair. The expression is serious with a closed mouth and no spectacles. Fine upper-lip strands versus nasal shadow are genuinely indistinct; do not invent a prominent moustache or beard. The subject wears a dark blue/navy open jacket over a white/pale shirt collar and a small dark grey necktie area. Ensure a rounded chin immediately meets a raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid separate yellow neck shafts, pointed V funnels, pinched collars, neck rolls, floating collars, clipping, or cream belly bibs. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front/rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual source color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated where they are indistinct in the source.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED nearly frontal/mildly IMAGE-LEFT civilian bust, short neatly side-parted DARK BROWN/BLACK hair with high forehead and real brow HAIR. Understated smooth upper lip/chin, serious CLOSED mouth, no spectacles. Fine upper-lip strands versus nasal shadow genuinely indistinct, do not invent a prominent moustache or beard. Dark BLUE/NAVY OPEN jacket over WHITE/PALE shirt collar and small DARK GREY necktie area beside note. Preserve actual primary head roll, blue/grey light and crop; no military uniform or cap.
Preserve actual real hair and eyebrow HAIR and source-matching mouth. One compact near-round yellow head with clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately resting on raised/broadened existing collar; very short broad transition, no human long neck/angular jaw, pointed V lower-face funnel, shaft, pinched collar, rolls, floating cloth, clipping or cream belly bib. Keep exact source lighting, frame/backing/note and all dark clothes opaque. Image1 exact original card; Image2 user mascot identity/anatomy only. Fine ambiguous details stay understated, no invented symbols, readable text, labels, watermark, extra figures or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed original small primary, raw fullsize output, paired source/output sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels. Keeps short dark side-part hair, real brows, serious closed mouth, clean understated upper lip/chin, navy open suit, white shirt and small grey tie; fine primary upper-lip shading remains uncertain rather than invented facial hair. Yellow lower face nevertheless narrows to a pointed V above the tie instead of a compact rounded short chin immediately meeting the raised broad neckline. Separate exact-master builtin geometry repair, retaining hair, pose, lighting, suit and note. Opaque backing/frame/garment show no internal alpha holes.
